blocks.name: Spindle
blocks.comment:
need to handle
SV_PC_COMMANDED_SPINDLE_SPEED (input)
SV_PC_CONFIG_MIN_SPINDLE_SPEED (input)
SV_PC_CONFIG_MAX_SPINDLE_SPEED (input)
SV_PLC_SPINDLE_SPEED (output)
SV_PLC_SPINDLE_KNOB (output for override)
SV_STOP (input for emergency stop)

here is all of them 

Written To (PLC - CNC Software):
SV_PLC_SPINDLE_KNOB - Spindle speed override percentage (1-200%)
SV_PLC_SPINDLE_SPEED - Current spindle speed reported to display
SV_SPINDLE_LOW_RANGE - Flag indicating low gear range active
SV_SPINDLE_MID_RANGE - Flag indicating mid gear range active
Read From (CNC Software - PLC):
SV_PC_COMMANDED_SPINDLE_SPEED - Commanded spindle speed (with override already applied)
SV_PC_CONFIG_MIN_SPINDLE_SPEED - Minimum spindle speed from configuration
SV_PC_CONFIG_MAX_SPINDLE_SPEED - Maximum spindle speed from configuration
SV_PROGRAM_RUNNING - Flag indicating a program is running
SV_MDI_MODE - Flag indicating MDI mode is active
SV_FORCE_PROBE_DETECTION_ON - Force probe detection mode
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_65 - Gear range 1 (low) speed adjustment ratio
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_66 - Gear range 2 (med-low) speed adjustment ratio
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_416 - Probe spindle inhibit mode setting
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_420 - Spindle DAC mode/frequency setting (Acorn6)
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_451 - External USB feed rate multiplier
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_455 - Custom spindle override percentage
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_459 - Second spindle enable setting
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_814 - Aux DAC PWM frequency setting
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_969 - PWM VM mode setting
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_982 - Spindle speed variation cycle time
SV_MACHINE_PARAMETER_983 - Spindle speed variation adjustment amount
SV_PC_RIGID_TAP_SPINDLE_OFF - Rigid tapping spindle off flag
SV_STOP - Emergency stop flag
SV_LIMIT_TRIPPED - Limit switch tripped flag
